description: Drag one thing onto another — reorder a list, move a card between columns, pull a slider handle, draw on a canvas. Give a "from" element (or "fromPoint") to pick up and a "to" element (or "toPoint") to drop on. Both ends must be on screen at the same moment, because nothing auto-scrolls mid-drag. The web has two unrelated drag mechanisms and "auto" chooses between them by reading the grabbed element: "pointer" presses, moves and releases a pointer, which is what dnd-kit, react-beautiful-dnd, sliders and canvases listen for; "native" fires the HTML5 dragstart/dragover/drop sequence with a DataTransfer, which is what an element carrying draggable="true" expects. The drop point is measured before the drag starts, so a list that reflows as you pass over it can land a slot out — raise "steps" and "settleMs", then read the result back. Set "trusted" when the page ignores synthetic events; that path is pointer-only, Chrome-only, and shows the “Browsentic is debugging this browser” bar. If nothing moved, check "accepted" and try the other mode.

from.description: Element to pick up — the card, row, or drag handle. Give this or "fromPoint", never both.

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

fromPoint.description: Viewport coordinates to grab from, in CSS pixels. Use it when the grip is not an element, such as a spot on a <canvas>.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the viewport

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the viewport

holdMs.description: How long the button stays down before the drag starts moving. Raise it past a library’s press-and-hold delay.

mode.description: Which drag mechanism to use. "auto" picks "native" when the grabbed element declares draggable="true", "pointer" otherwise.

scrollIntoView.description: Bring the grabbed element into view first. Ignored with "fromPoint".

settleMs.description: Pause on the drop point before releasing, letting the page settle on where the item would land.

steps.description: Moves dispatched along the way to the drop point. Raise it for lists that reorder as the pointer passes over them.

to.description: Element to drop onto — the destination column, list slot, or drop zone. Give this or "toPoint", never both.

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

toPoint.description: Viewport coordinates to drop at, in CSS pixels. Use it to reach empty space, a slider position, or a spot on a <canvas>.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the viewport

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the viewport

trusted.description: Dispatch real browser-level mouse events, so isTrusted is true. Pointer mode only, Chrome only.

name: page_dragElement
